rows.grounds: gloss 'by-instruction-and-extension' + form abhyāṃ indicates instrumental dual masculine
gloss 'what-was-said' + form uktaṃ indicates passive participle; yad is relative pronoun
gloss 'in-those-words-and-so-on' + form ādiṣu indicates locative plural
gloss 'again-indicated' + form tidiṣṭaṃ indicates passive participle; bhūyo is indeclinable
gloss 'in-scripture-our-heart-lord' + form śāstre/īśvare indicates locative singular; compound membership uncertain
